summary: The Brink's Company filed an 8-K disclosing an acquisition of NCR Atleos Corporation via a two-step merger. On February 26, 2026, Brink's, NCR Atleos, and merger subsidiaries entered into a merger agreement where Merger Sub I will merge into NCR Atleos, followed by a second merger into Merger Sub II. The S-4 registration statement was declared effective on May 27, 2026. Special meetings are set for June 30, 2026, for shareholder votes. Two shareholder lawsuits filed in New York Supreme Court challenge the merger, alleging negligent misrepresentation in NCR Atleos's proxy statement. Watch for litigation outcomes and shareholder approval; the risk-arb spread may reflect deal uncertainty.
